proposal.summary: The cart total summed each product's unit price once instead of multiplying by its quantity, so 3 items plus shipping showed as one item plus shipping; the change multiplies both units and nanos by quantity when computing the total.

reasons: The patch fixes the repeated walkout cause by multiplying each item price by quantity, so three items at $101.96 plus $26.97 shipping no longer total $128.93.
It correctly multiplies both units and nanos and preserves the existing nanos carry into units when computing the total.
It is the smallest targeted change, confined to the cart total calculation in CartItems.tsx.
The find string matches the original file exactly once as shown.
Quantity is already available on each productList entry, so the change does not introduce a new data requirement or break surrounding cart rendering.
